title: orient-nexus-graft
intention: GRAFT the orient instrument's LEARNING PATH to the question-nexus shape (charter filed edge (f), cast by the nexi-everywhere ruling, held-nexi-everywhere). The fire-path does not move: scans stay HARDWARE — deterministic, replayable, changed only by installation (tooth 12's dated-correction provenance + Akien's ratification), the tree never consulted at measure-time. What grafts is the GROWTH: orient gains a tree stratum for its correction corpus (its own table, owner 'orient', through the same generalized tools chart-tree proves), and when a correction would grow a scan, the proposal runs through the nexus loop — corpus walked, ceiling drafting the scan, admission through the unchanged gate. Its learnings COMPILE INTO the scan registry; they never fire from the tree.
why: Akien, verbatim, 2026-07-28: 'building ANYTHING should be the learning event for the orient/inspector tickets.' The event the charter edge filed ('the first correction that would grow a scan') is REDEFINED and thereby FIRED: every build exercises orient (every build orients), so every build is a learning opportunity, and the stone being cast today (chart-tree) is a build — the ticket casts now. The deeper why is the ruling's own: 'this would make every unit a learning unit without having to supervise that' — orient was born a learning device with a bespoke prose growth path; the graft gives it the one shared shape.
traces_to: Law 1 — a correction class deposits once and compiles into a scan; the ceiling is spent only on the novel proposal
Law 3 — the wrong-shape signal keeps its teeth: a registry static across corrections is a dead learner; the dial reads it
Law 4 — admission stays physics: tooth 12 refuses a scan without dated-correction provenance, ratification stays Akien's
Law 7 — a measurement is always hardware: replayable (same input + same registry revision = same verdict), so it may be permanent in a record of truth
Law 8 — grafting one ticket at a time; falsifier (3) — inference laundered as measurement — keeps its teeth throughout

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate under the tester when built: the graft's teeth join test_orient.py (or a sibling proof) — the fire-path teeth (12, 15, 13-14) stay green untouched throughout; new teeth pin tree-never-at-measure-time and admission-only-by-installation. Live gate: the first real correction that grows a scan arrives through the loop, its provenance naming both the correction and the tree walk that drafted it.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a scan admitted without a dated correction in its provenance (tooth 12's claim, unchanged); the tree consulted at measure-time (a live tree-walk verdict is not replayable — the hardware ruling's sharpest line); a fire-path tooth going red during the graft (the graft is additive or it is not a graft); the correction corpus written outside orient's own owned table (Law 6).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when chart-tree PROVES (the dependency clears and BUILDME can fire); when the first correction lands through the loop (the live gate's event); when the dial over orient's registry has enough admissions to show the growth trend.
